note: Female soldier in a green cap and fatigues, front view. Cap, dark hair (side locks to y~442) and face are head: chin y~415. Neck, collar, jacket with insignia, crossing straps, belt with buckle, the jacket skirt (hem y~710) and the dark coat tails on both sides and between the legs, and the dark/brown item hanging below the right fist (x627-732, y665-732, read as a rifle stock or strap, torso), are torso; hip = jacket hem y~710. Arms: both sleeves are plain green with no mark, so the elbows are halfway guesses between the shoulder (y~450) and the wrist: left elbow y515, wrist y574 (pale fingers x318-364 y574-644 on the weapon); right elbow y523, wrist y~590 (pale fist y586-664). The dark weapon at the left (muzzle at x~262,y~545, down to the fingers at y~644) is treated as held in the left hand, so it is equipment, kept off the hand; it could instead be the end of a slung rifle (torso), which is uncertain. The trousers run into the boots with no knee mark and the boot tops (y~810) are below halfway hip to ankle, so knee = halfway y~788 on both legs; ankles y~862 (left) and y~873 (right) where the toes flare.
